notes.title: I FINALLY CAVED OKAY FINE!!!!!!
notes.content:
Hey my wonderful very very very niche fanbase!!

I finally gave in and did it..... after all of the complaints.

I finally Nerfed Level 2. Mainly talking about the boss, Mr. Tree.

Changes:
Mr. Tree Health:
100 -> 65

I hope people can now enjoy the game and keep playing!

notes.title: About Level 2....
notes.content:
~~~~ ABOUT LEVEL 2.... THE FOREST LEVEL. ~~~~ːsteamfacepalmː

I've recently gotten some feedback regarding level 2. I've heard that people can't even beat it on fragile mode, and it makes the game unplayable. 


Well.... 



I'm thinking of nerfing level 2. I know I know, I'm not supposed to care, but heh... I'm only human after all..... 



Comment on this if you CAN NOT beat level 2. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: HEY GUYS!!!!
notes.content:
WHATS UP MY WONDERFUL FANBASE!!!!

~~~We added a fragile mode to the game for Lilja and Baylie because its too hard for them.~~~

This new mode may be a little finicky but you should be able to play with it. You will not earn certain achievements if you beat the game on Fragile Mode.

HAVE FUN!!!
